feeds.title: Prison Legal News
feeds.description: Prison Legal News, a project of the Human Rights Defense Center, is an independent monthly magazine that provides cutting-edge review and analysis of prisoners' rights, court rulings, and news concerning criminal justice-related issues.

feeds.title: Prison Policy Initiative Blog
feeds.description: The Prison Policy Initiative was founded in 2001 to document and publicize how over-criminalization undermines our national welfare. This blog provides research and advocacy about how mass incarceration affects individuals, communities and the national welfare.

feeds.title: Prison Fellowship Blog
feeds.description: Prison Fellowship works to bring hope and restoration to prisoners, families, and communities impacted by crime and incarceration.

feeds.title: Between the Bars
feeds.description: Between the Bars is a weblog platform for people in prison, from which the 1% of America is behind bars who tell their stories. We hope to improve prisoner's lives, and help to reduce recidivism.

feeds.title: Prison Performing Arts Blog
feeds.description: Know more about our programs, arts, events, and celebrities collaborating with us. Prison Performing Arts is a multi-discipline, literacy and performing arts program that serves incarcerated adults and children.

feeds.title: Penal Reform International Blog
feeds.description: Explore our blog to know more about our work on prison systems, conditions, prisoner rights and more! Penal Reform International (PRI) is a non-governmental organisation working globally to promote criminal justice systems that uphold human rights for all and do no harm.

feeds.title: Virginia Prisons Accountability Committee
feeds.description: Virginia Prisons Accountability Commitee exist because of law. We are organized to ensure that the Department of Corrections complies with the Law

feeds.title: Sing Sing Prison Museum Blog
feeds.description: The blog will tell the story of Sing Sing Prison and American history and house an education center for criminal justice.Sing Sing Correctional Facility is an active, maximum-security prison where the theories and realities of criminal punishment and rehabilitation have played out for almost 200 years. It's a place with diverse stories from multiple perspectives. As an emerging voice, our goal is to deliver new ways of understanding for a fairer future.

feeds.title: Gove.UK Blog » Prison Jobs
feeds.description: Our posts are for prison officer applicants and those interested in careers within the prison service. Find Official advice and guidance for applicants to prison and probation roles, run by the Ministry of Justice. Gov.UK is The best place to find government services and information.

feeds.title: WriteAPrisoner Blog
feeds.description: Here you will find blog entries from inmates all around the country. The prisoner blogs are all posted by active members of WriteAPrisoner.com. We post inmate pen-pal, legal, and reintegration profiles on our website. You decide who to write from the thousands of profiles of incarcerated men and women we have listed.

feeds.title: Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation
feeds.description: Source for the California Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation's breaking news on prison and parole reforms, inmates, riots, courts, escapes and more. CDCR has approximately 114,000 inmates in 35 prisons, 3,500 in camps, 4,200 out of state, 670 juveniles.

feeds.title: Prisoners' Education Trust Blog
feeds.description: We feature the latest news about our work and share views from our staff and other prison education experts. Since 1989 Prisoners' Education Trust has been providing access to broader learning opportunities for prisoners. Our charity supports prisoners across England and Wales to study distance learning courses. We aim to improve prison education research, policy and practice.

feeds.title: Sustainability in Prisons Project Blog
feeds.description: KNow more about our work for sustainability in our blog. SPP brings together incarcerated individuals, scientists, corrections staff, students, and program partners to promote education, conserve biodiversity, practice sustainability, and help build healthy communities.

feeds.title: Crossroads Prison Ministries Blog
feeds.description: Get news and stories from Crossroads Prison Ministries. At Crossroads, we connect prisoners with volunteer mentors on the outside. Unlikely friendships are formed, and the lives of both prisoners and mentors are changed as they exchange letters, study God's Word and apply biblical truths to their lives.

feeds.title: Prison Journalism Project
feeds.description: A non-profit, non-partisan national organization that aims to empower incarcerated journalists to be a vital voice in criminal justice reform.

feeds.title: Prison: The Hidden Sentence Podcast
feeds.description: Welcome. The purpose of this podcast and it's blog is to help educate and empower those who have or had a loved one in prison. Raising awareness one story at a time.Did you know that the chances are very high that someone you know has had a loved one incarcerated? Or maybe you are part of the millions of people in the US population who has had a loved one in the prison system? This Podcast is for you. Indirectly we are all affected, and if you have a loved one in prison you are probably doing the time even though you committed no crime...

feeds.title: Inmate Blogger
feeds.description: This site is a collection of blogs written by inmates. It serves as a platform which allows them to share their stories, their opinions, their struggles, and their inner thoughts.

feeds.title: For the Lives of Prison Wives
feeds.description: If you want to learn more about the journey of family sticking together through the wall, the challenges of the criminal justice system, and the road to redemption you're in the right place. This blog is to share my personal experience as a prison wife in hopes of supporting, encouraging and bringing awareness to others in similar situations.

feeds.title: Light in prison
feeds.description: Healing our prisons and those in them

feeds.title: Uncovered Injustice
feeds.description: Uncovered Injustice

feeds.title: Prison Phone Blog
feeds.description: The Prison Phone blog looks into all aspects of the criminal justice system. Specifically focused on the UK prison service. Prison Phone allows prisoners to stay in contact with friends and family by reducing the cost of their calls from prison

feeds.title: A Voice from Prison Blog
feeds.description: Follow our Blog, A Voice from Prison, to read more about Criminal Justice Reform and Constitutional Rights within the Prison Justice System. A Voice From Prison is a non-profit advocating criminal justice reform and constitutional rights, directly from within the system itself.

feeds.title: DoingFedTime
feeds.description: Federal Prison Consultants who answer questions and educate people about what federal prison is really like.

feeds.title: Prison Reform Trust News
feeds.description: The Prison Reform Trust (PRT) an independent UK charity working to create a just, humane and effective penal system. By monitoring and reporting on developments in the penal system, the Prison Reform Trust continues to perform an important role in bringing to light information for public and parliamentary debate.

feeds.title: Derrick's Prison Blog
feeds.description: Explore Blogs about the experiences of Derrick L. Griffin during his imprisonment. We are friends who make it possible that the experiences of Derrick L. Griffin incarcerated in prison are published via this blog and that, in this way, much support for him is created to reopen his case and to prove his innocence.

feeds.title: Canadian Prison Law Association
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates from the association. THE CANADIAN PRISON LAW ASSOCIATION made its transformative appearance on the correctional law stage in 1985, but the 'prep' work for its arrival extends back decades, and must be recognized.
